object: rho63 arena: Moser-lattice disk of radius^2 = 147456/9072 in Q(sqrt3,sqrt11), plus its image under rho63=(31+3i*sqrt7)/32 about the shared centre, plus all unit edges

coupling.note: the 30 centre-star edges merely make the copy centre proper; the 30 redundant ones duplicate base unit edges

reduction: arena 4-colourable IFF two proper 4-colourings f,g of the base exist with f(centre)=g(centre), f(v)!=g(v) at all 30 diagonal circle points, and f(i)!=g(j) at the 36 off-diagonal pairs
wlog: a global colour permutation applied to BOTH f and g pins the centre colour to 0
claims_a_reviewer_must_verify: C1 (ONE UNSAT): with the centre pinned to colour 0 and all 19 circle patterns blocked, the base half is unsatisfiable -- so every proper 4-colouring of the base presents one of the 19 on the circle

C2 (19 UNSATs): for each circle pattern k, with the centre and that pattern pinned and its listed off-diagonal patterns blocked, the base half is unsatisfiable -- so the listed off-diagonal patterns are all of them
C4 (FINITE, no solver): no ordered pair of the 552 listed interface patterns satisfies all 66 disequalities
not_load_bearing: C3, that each listed pattern is actually achievable, is NOT needed for the refutation: the argument only requires the listed set to be a SUPERSET of the achievable patterns, and a spurious extra pattern can only make C4 harder to pass. (It was nevertheless verified for the 19 circle patterns, each exhibited by a proper colouring checked against the 272,232-edge base list.)
argument: every proper 4-colouring C of the arena yields f(v)=C(v) and g(v)=C(Rv), both proper 4-colourings of the base, with f(centre)=g(centre) and the 66 disequalities
by C1+C2 the interface patterns of f and of g both lie in the listed 552 (after the WLOG colour permutation)
by C4 no such pair exists
therefore the arena has no proper 4-colouring
